ratification: independent ratification pass 1 applied (E-A..E-G); see source document section 0
sigma_definition: sigma_seed(m): pooled standard deviation of frozen probe metric m across independent-seed replicas at matched step counts, measured at R1 scale with >= T-07 seeds, filed as receipt R1-E7. Substituting measured sigma values into F-* formulas is mechanical and receipted, not an amendment.
sigma_credit_definition: sigma_credit(m) = max(sigma_seed(m) where R1-E7 measures m, sigma_eval(m)). sigma_eval(m): per-benchmark evaluation-variance bound - item-level nonparametric bootstrap standard error (10000 resamples) or exact binomial standard error for accuracy-type metrics - computed from and receipted with the frozen eval itself. Max widens the band, the stricter direction for credit predicates. (E-C)

adjudication_rules.no_signal: A between-arm delta with abs(delta) <= T-20 * sigma_seed(m) adjudicates NO-SIGNAL: a third outcome, creditable to no arm.
adjudication_rules.r2_asymmetry: R2 evidence can kill an arm and fire F1's pivot; no A3-superiority claim is creditable from R2 alone. Superiority claims require the R3 sustained-regime re-check.
adjudication_rules.capacity_confounded: A rung where any compared arm breaches its utilization bounds (T-13/T-14) is flagged CAPACITY-CONFOUNDED: usable for kill decisions, never for credit, inadmissible as a frontier-receipt advantage leg.
adjudication_rules.data_stream_law: All arms at a rung consume the identical frozen data stream (source manifest, shuffle seed, batch schedule, cursor discipline), receipted per arm; a mismatch voids the comparison for credit.
adjudication_rules.forecast_miss: (E-A) An F-02 exit-band breach with all kill predicates green adjudicates FORECAST-MISS, not hard rung-fail: mandatory anomaly + failure-library entry + forecast-recalibration receipt + pivot receipt, all required before R3 funding.
adjudication_rules.matched_budget_credit: (E-B) F-08 final credit is adjudicated at matched cumulative charged budget: the control's final checkpoint vs A3's own hash-chained checkpoint at the control's budget point. T-19 floors the control's continuation budget for trajectory evidence only and is never the credit denominator.

entries.formula: abs(loss(t) - powerlaw_fit_R1(t)) <= T-20 * sigma_seed(loss) * sqrt(t / T-01); fit = least-squares power law over R1 steps 20..100
entries.meaning: (E-A) R2-E1 predicted loss band, horizon-widened by the frozen estimator's extrapolation uncertainty; breach with kills green = FORECAST-MISS (receipts forced), not hard rung-fail

Matched-control catastrophic-loss kill margin

entries.formula: credit iff delta_m(A3@B_ctrl - control@B_ctrl) > +(T-20 * sigma_credit(m)) on the frozen suite; B_ctrl = control's cumulative charged budget; A3@B_ctrl = A3's own hash-chained checkpoint at that budget point; sigma_credit per sigma_credit_definition
entries.meaning: (E-B, E-C) R4-E5 final matched-control required positive delta at matched cumulative charged budget

entries.formula: reproduced metric within T-20 * sigma_credit(m) of the claimed value (fresh seed, same frozen config); sigma_credit per sigma_credit_definition

entries.formula: two-segment least-squares slope fit in log(capability) vs log(cumulative_proxy_joules); break admitted only if post-break slope holds over >= one full held-out T-18-step segment recorded after the claim
entries.meaning: Breakpoint estimator for frontier-bend claims

entries.formula: mean_t abs(loss_mech(t) - loss_ref(t)) <= T-20 * sigma_seed(loss) AND abs(grad_norm_ratio - 1) <= T-20 * sigma_seed(grad_norm_ratio), over T-09 matched steps, same model/data/seed, ref = CPU-offloaded full-state AdamW
entries.meaning: (E-E) A1 parity band (R1-E8 leg 2); doc and JSON harmonized to per-metric sigma_seed(grad_norm_ratio)
